journal.sanguinaire.saw.title: The Surgical Saw
journal.sanguinaire.saw.text: Every creature carries something worth taking. Fell one with the Surgical Saw as the final cut and, besides its usual remains, it always yields one special specimen. Rarer organs are harder to come by. Study specimens at a Research Station to learn which transformations they belong to.
journal.sanguinaire.mutation.goatman: A towering, long-limbed brute crowned with a horned goat skull, walking on hooves and clawing with black talons. Every kill feeds it (4 hunger), falls hurt it only half as much, it strides up whole blocks without breaking pace, and its blows knock shields aside for 10 seconds. At will, it lets loose a roar that roots every creature nearby in place for a moment and saps their strength (Weakness II) for 5 seconds. Recovery: 20 seconds.
journal.sanguinaire.mutation.rotting_abo: A stitched-together horror of three arms and two heads, sewn from every breed of zombie. Whoever strikes it reels with sickness (Nausea II, 15 seconds), arrows and other missiles glance off its hide, and while it stands unhurt no single blow can fell it: it clings on at half a heart instead. Too heavy to jump, it simply strides up whole blocks. At will, it retches a gout of acidic bile that burns whatever it drenches for 10 damage and poisons it for 10 seconds. Recovery: 10 seconds.
journal.sanguinaire.mutation.fadehound: A lean, dark hound that is almost all mouth, watching through four glowing violet eyes. Nothing can slow it. Struck, it melts from sight for 4 seconds and leaves its attacker blinded for 8. Its bite finds the gaps in any armor, and after nightfall it runs faster and leaps higher. At will, it slips through the shadows to wherever it is looking, up to 16 blocks away, mending half its wounds and becoming untouchable for 2 seconds. Recovery: 4 seconds.
journal.sanguinaire.mutation.creeper: Green, hissing and patient. Monsters accept you as one of their own, though your stubby limbs are useless in a fight. At will, you detonate in a blast that ends the transformation at once.
journal.sanguinaire.mutation.zombie: The endless hunger of the shambling dead. Monsters pay you no mind, but daylight sets your rotting skin alight, and any villager you slay rises again as a Zombie Villager.
journal.sanguinaire.mutation.husk: Parched flesh from the deserts, untroubled by the sun. Monsters pay you no mind, your blows leave a gnawing hunger in their victims (Hunger II, 3 seconds), and villagers you slay rise again as Zombie Villagers.
journal.sanguinaire.mutation.drowned: Waterlogged and bloated from the deep. Monsters pay you no mind, your lungs never need air beneath the waves, and villagers you slay rise again as Zombie Villagers.
journal.sanguinaire.mutation.spider: Eight legs and a patient appetite. Monsters treat you as kin, walls are as easy to climb as floors, and cobwebs part for you like curtains.
journal.sanguinaire.mutation.venomous_sp: The smaller, crueller cousin of the spider. Monsters treat you as kin, you scale walls and slip through cobwebs, and every bite carries venom (Poison I, 8 seconds).
journal.sanguinaire.mutation.phantom: Membranous wings stitched from sleepless nights. Monsters ignore you and the sky is yours to roam, but the sun scorches you as it does all the undead.
journal.sanguinaire.mutation.warden: The blind sentinel of the deep dark. You feel the world rather than see it, sensing only what moves. Your footsteps never stir the sculk, fire cannot harm you, and other Wardens accept you as one of their own. At will, you gather a sonic shriek in your chest and loose it through stone and flesh alike. Recovery: 20 seconds.
journal.sanguinaire.mutation.enderman: A tall, crooked shadow from the End. Monsters ignore you and other Endermen meet your stare without anger, though the world looks turned inside out through your eyes, and water and rain burn like acid. At will, you blink to wherever you are looking. Recovery: 2 seconds.
journal.sanguinaire.mutation.ghast: A weeping cloud of the Nether. Ghasts and piglins leave you in peace, flame cannot touch you, and you drift freely through the air. At will, you let out a mournful wail and spit a fireball. Recovery: 4 seconds.
journal.sanguinaire.mutation.guardian: A spined sentry of the ocean monuments. Other Guardians let you pass and you breathe and dart swiftly underwater, but dry air slowly suffocates you. At will, you fix your eye on a creature and charge a searing beam. Recovery: 5 seconds.
journal.sanguinaire.mutation.elder_guard: The ancient keeper of the monument. Guardians of every kind let you pass and the sea is yours to breathe and roam, though land slowly suffocates you, and every so often nearby enemies are seized by a crushing fatigue (Mining Fatigue III). At will, you charge a beam faster than any lesser Guardian. Recovery: 5 seconds.
journal.sanguinaire.mutation.villager: The humble face of the village. Villagers and Iron Golems trust you and every trade comes cheaper, but you have no stomach for fighting. At will, you call the nearest willing villager within 10 blocks to trade.
journal.sanguinaire.mutation.wolf: Fur, fang and a hunter's instincts. Skeletons and sheep flee at the sight of you.
journal.sanguinaire.mutation.goat: Sure-footed as any mountain dweller. No fall, however great, can hurt you.
journal.sanguinaire.weakened.title: Weakened Hearts
journal.sanguinaire.weakened.intro: The body does not forgive what we do to it. Each time a transformation runs its course and foreign flesh is cast out, it leaves something behind: a heart gone pale and sickly purple, a Weakened Heart.
journal.sanguinaire.weakened.gained: Every transformation serum costs half a heart once its effects end, even if death ends it early. The toll accumulates without limit; a reckless surgeon can turn their entire life into Weakened Hearts. Utility serums such as Tainted Blood and Physical Boost exact no such price.
journal.sanguinaire.weakened.effects: Weakened Hearts sit atop your health. They never mend with rest or a full stomach, and the Regeneration effect cannot reach them. While any of them still beats, every physical blow you take deals one extra point of damage. Even half a heart suffers all of this. They persist through death. They vanish while you are transformed or bolstered by a Physical Boost serum, and return afterwards.
journal.sanguinaire.weakened.cure: Instant Health and similar immediate remedies can refill a Weakened Heart, though it remains weakened. Only a true brush with death undoes the damage: die while carrying a Totem of Undying and let it pull you back, and every Weakened Heart is restored to health.
journal.sanguinaire.serum.tainted_blood: A thick, near-black draught that never truly leaves the veins. Once injected, it stains the blood for good, loosening the body's grip on its own design. Foreign strands of flesh are tolerated far longer before they are rejected. A single dose is all the body will ever take. Every transformation you undergo afterwards lasts 30 seconds longer.
Your blood already carries the taint.
journal.sanguinaire.serum.physical_boost: A golden tonic that swells the muscle fibres and drives the heart to work beyond its means. For 2 minutes you are under Physical Boost: your blows land as hard as with Strength II, and your Weakened Hearts are forced to beat like healthy ones, vanishing from your health bar. When the tonic wears off, the weakness returns.
message.sanguinaire.already_tainted: Your blood is already tainted. It will take no more.
message.sanguinaire.blood_tainted: Something dark settles into your veins. Your body will bear foreign flesh for longer.
message.sanguinaire.physical_boost: Your muscles swell and your weakened hearts surge with borrowed strength.
message.sanguinaire.physical_boost_ended: The tonic fades. Your weakened hearts falter once more.
message.sanguinaire.torn_page_read: You wrote down what you learned on your journal.
message.sanguinaire.torn_page_no_journal: I don't know what to do with it.
message.sanguinaire.torn_page_known: These notes hold nothing your journal doesn't already know.
journal.sanguinaire.serum.revitalizing: A bright green restorative, distilled to do in a single breath what a brewer's potion does in a dozen. Injected, it floods the body with life as Instant Health II would, and like any true instant remedy it can refill even Weakened Hearts, though they remain weakened.

journal.sanguinaire.blood.monster: Thick, dark and foul, drawn from the hostile things of the world and from anything with too many legs. It fights whatever body it enters.
journal.sanguinaire.blood.monster.serum: Mixed into a transformation serum at the Serum Synthesizer, the creature hits harder (+10 damage on every blow) and shrugs off harm (2 less damage from every hit). The body pays for it afterwards: 4 more Weakened Hearts, and Weakness and Slowness for 2 minutes.
journal.sanguinaire.blood.animal: Warm, bright and clean, drawn from beasts, fish and fowl. The body accepts it almost gratefully.
journal.sanguinaire.blood.animal.serum: Mixed into a transformation serum at the Serum Synthesizer, it eases the return to your own flesh: when the transformation ends you are left with Speed and Regeneration for 8 seconds, and no extra Weakened Hearts.
journal.sanguinaire.blood.humanoid: Drawn from villagers, illagers and people, yourself included. It is the closest match to your own, and the body is slow to notice the foreign flesh it carries.
journal.sanguinaire.blood.humanoid.serum: Mixed into a transformation serum at the Serum Synthesizer, the transformation lasts 30 seconds longer. Once it ends, the body rejects it all the harder: 2 more Weakened Hearts.
journal.sanguinaire.blood.drawing: Sneak and use an Empty Syringe on a creature to draw its blood, at the cost of a small wound. Sneak and use it on the open air to draw your own. Place a Blood Sample in the Synthesizer's blood slot and it is mixed into the next transformation serum brewed there.
journal.sanguinaire.blood.altering: In a Sanguine Alembic, a Blood Sample and a drinkable potion become an Altered Blood Sample. The potion's effect is bound to the blood and takes hold when the transformation it was mixed into comes to an end.
journal.sanguinaire.weakened.decay: Push the body far enough and it begins to rot from within. Once half of your health is Weakened Hearts, your blows land weaker (5 less damage), a shield gives way the moment it blocks anything, and hunger gnaws faster. Once every heart is weakened it grows worse still: Strength and Resistance no longer take hold, villagers charge you more, and hunger gnaws faster yet. The rot sleeps while you are transformed.

journal.sanguinaire.block.research_stati: A workbench for dissection and study. Place a specimen, either a body part or a Blood Sample, in the top slot and a Research Journal in the bottom slot. After 10 seconds the specimen is consumed and what it taught is written into your journal. The work belongs to whoever last opened the station, so every researcher keeps their own discoveries, and each finished study grants a little experience. A specimen you already know is never wasted.
Hoppers above or beside the station can feed it specimens and a journal. It still answers to its researcher, though: whoever last opened it must be online for a study to begin and to finish.
journal.sanguinaire.block.serum_synthesi: Where specimens become serums. Place three ingredients in the top slots, in any order, and an Empty Syringe in the bottom slot. After 25 seconds the syringe is filled with the serum they make; combinations that make nothing are never consumed. The slot on the left takes an optional Blood Sample, which is mixed into the next transformation serum brewed. Each finished serum releases experience.

Hoppers above or beside it feed ingredients, Empty Syringes and Blood Samples into their proper slots, each different ingredient into a slot of its own. Finished serums drop into a chest or any other container directly below, or can be pulled out by a hopper underneath.
journal.sanguinaire.block.sanguine_alemb: A delicate still for binding potions to blood. Place a Blood Sample in the left slot and a drinkable potion in the right. After 30 seconds the blood takes on the potion's effect and becomes an Altered Blood Sample, leaving an empty bottle behind. Blood can only be altered once, and only a potion's first effect is bound. Each altering releases a little experience.
Hoppers above or beside it feed Blood Samples and potions into their slots. A hopper underneath pulls out finished samples and the empty bottles.
enchantment.sanguinaire.vivisection.desc: Surgical Saw only. Deals 9 extra damage to creatures whose specimens you have fully researched in your Journal.
